# Pixel Tasks — Offline Pixel-Style Task List

A self-contained, offline task list with a pixel-art look. Built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no packages, no network requests, no storage. All state lives in memory and resets on reload.

## How to run

Open `index.html` directly in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Files

- `index.html` — markup and labeled controls
- `style.css` — pixel-themed styling (palette, layout, focus/hover/pressed states)
- `script.js` — in-memory task logic and rendering
- `README.md` — this file

## Controls

- **Task input** (`#todo-input`) — type a task; blank/whitespace-only input is ignored
- **Add** (`#todo-add`) — adds the trimmed task, or press Enter
- **Total** (`#todo-total`) — integer count of all tasks, starts at 0
- **Remaining** (`#remaining`) — integer count of incomplete tasks, starts at 0
- **Checkbox** (`#todo-check-N`) — toggles completion and updates remaining count
- **Delete** (`#todo-delete-N`) — removes the task and updates both counts
- **Task text** (`#todo-text-N`) — displayed task label

Tasks receive increasing numeric IDs starting at 1, so the first task uses `#todo-text-1`, `#todo-check-1`, and `#todo-delete-1`.

## Accessibility

All controls have labels or `aria-label` attributes, are keyboard operable, and show visible focus, hover, and pressed states. Counts are announced via `aria-live`.

## Constraints

- Fully offline; no external assets or imports
- State is in memory only (no `localStorage`/`sessionStorage`)
- Layout works down to 360px wide
- Total source under 240 lines
